name: @solar-icons/blazor-tools
description: Private generation and verification tools for the Blazor NuGet package

scripts.format: oxfmt --check scripts tests/browser playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.format:fix: oxfmt --write scripts tests/browser playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.test:dotnet: dotnet run --project tests/RenderChecks -c Release -f net8.0 && dotnet run --project tests/RenderChecks -c Release -f net10.0
scripts.test:package: dotnet run --project probes/PackageConsumer -c Release -f net8.0 && dotnet run --project probes/PackageConsumer -c Release -f net10.0
scripts.test:browser: dotnet build tools/StaticHost -c Release && dotnet build ../../apps/blazor-app/SolarIcons.Playground -c Release && playwright test
